title: Forfeiture.
bodyText: All imitation controlled substances are subject to forfeiture according to the procedures set forth in chapter 712A.
bodyHtml: §329C-3  Forfeiture.  All imitation controlled substances are subject to forfeiture according to the procedures set forth in chapter 712A. [L 1984, c 222, pt of §1; am L 1989, c 261, §13]
